item.title: Methodology
item.description:
Purpose

This project examines documented pro-Kremlin positions and possible influence pathways in the European Parliament. It is not a substitute for journalism, legal process, or the official register of Members of the European Parliament.

What qualifies for inclusion

Each future profile or case entry should identify the subject, the exact claim, the date, and one or more supporting sources. Prefer, in this order:

  1. Official parliamentary records, voting records, declarations, and speeches.
  2. Direct public statements, interviews, or publications by the subject.
  3. Court records, regulator findings, or official investigations.
  4. Reporting from established outlets that names its evidence and methodology.

Party affiliation, country of origin, and online association are context only; none independently establish a pro-Kremlin position or covert relationship.
